modelingDecisions: Use the mapped principal edge as a curved-facade reference; resample by arc length rather than allocating a window module to every uneven OSM edge.
Separate rear stair/lift projections from the habitable floor plate. Three stair projections correspond to open helices in the measured study, not closed cylinders.
Build continuous projecting brise slabs, support brackets, glazing behind the brises and distinct transfer levels. Exact brise section and offsets still need a directly inspected dimensional source.
Build cobogo openings as real perforations at close range, with geometric reveals and separate dark backing/interior surfaces as appropriate.
Keep the commercial podium separate. The original design section includes program and ramp details altered during execution and cannot alone establish its as-built shape.
Reuse shared ceramic mosaic, painted concrete, metal, glass and paving surfaces; add a canonical ceramic mosaic graph only if the existing library has no adequate material.
Model the documented decommissioned helipad without inferring current operational markings or equipment.
Reconcile unsigned map heading with a north-up site view and the primary-plan compass before approving geographic placement.
